The adults at Nilkantha market can't be reached: both of its roads are unusable. The toddler at Belkot village can be reached, but the round trip to Bidur shelter takes 186 minutes of driving, which costs more than the 60-minute child deferral penalty. So the lowest-cost plan defers both groups and the car stays put.

<plan>
defer belkot-village child 1
defer nilkantha-market adult 3
</plan>
